name: Lavenders (LAVNDR120)
description: Lavenders is a digital market system that brings together 120 businesses and brands in one market. Each business runs its own order-management app (OMS); their real orders feed one live consumer index called LAVNDR120. Lavenders is the brand; LAVNDR120 is the index. Unrelated to lavender plants or oil.

skills.name: Brand and package facts
skills.description: Answer questions about Lavenders, its seven packages, prices, seats and what it does not offer.

skills.name: Live index card
skills.description: Current LAVNDR120 net asset value and day change (informational).
